chart_insights.auditor_changes: Auditor changes remained modest and sporadic through 2023 (1–4 per year) before surging to 19 in 2025, likely driven by the mandatory transition from ETSI AAL v3.4 to v3.5 in March 2026, with a secondary wave of 7 changes already occurring in 2026.
chart_insights.self_report: ETSI CAs self-report compliance at 61.9% compared to 57.9% for WebTrust, a 4-point gap that may reflect differences in audit scope, self-assessment rigor, or population size rather than a systematic advantage in either program.
chart_insights.detection_rate: Auditors detected control failures in 25% of in-period cases (105 of 417), but detection rates vary sharply across firms—from 0% at five auditors to 100% at MATRIX Ltd.—indicating inconsistent audit quality or case selection rather than uniform ecosystem risk.
chart_insights.etsi_aal: ETSI CAs continue using versions 2 through 3.5, with 3 still running v3.3 (superseded in 2022) and 7 on v2 or v2.9 (5+ years outdated), while only 1 CA has adopted v3.5 despite its March 2026 mandatory deadline.

Forty OV TLS/SSL end-entity certificates contained invalid values for 'stateOrProvinceName', non-compliant with CA/B Forum B.R. section 7.1.6.4; identified June 28, 2021, root cause was logic condition incorrectly handled in production code; all affected certificates were revoked by June 30, 2021 and emergency code fix deployed June 29, 2021.

qualifications: LAWtrust-CA makes use of external registration authorities for specific subscriber registration activities as disclosed in LAWtrust-CA's business practices. Our procedures did not extend to the controls exercised by these external registration authorities.

LAWtrust-CA does not provide CA key escrow services, Certificate Renewal services and does not provide third-Party subordinate CA or cross certificate issuance or management services. Accordingly, our procedures did not extend to controls that would address those criteria.

During the course of our procedures, we noted that certain controls defined within the applicable criteria were not triggered during the audit period as there were no instances of the underlying operational events. Specifically, there were no instances of the CA Key Generation (including root CA keys), CA key Transportation, and CA key Archival. While these controls are documented within LAWtrust-CA's Certification Practice Statement's (CPS's), their implementation and operational effectiveness could not be evaluated during this engagement.
